tools.name: fetch_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any public BrightLocal page as clean markdown (page chrome stripped). Equivalent to GET {url} with Accept: text/markdown.

path.description: Path on the BrightLocal site (e.g. "/learn/", "/research/local-consumer-review-survey/"). Must begin with "/".

tools.name: list_discovery_resources
tools.description: List BrightLocal’s machine-readable content-discovery resources (llms.txt, agent-skills index, robots.txt). Useful as a starting point for exploring the site as an AI agent.
